</table>
<p id="A1.SS3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">implying standard ablation induces a capability penalty under Eq. <a href="#A1.E8" title="In A.2 First-Order Condition for “Lossless” Editing ‣ Appendix A Appendix A: Theoretical Analysis — Capability Preservation via Null Space Projection ‣ Surgical Refusal Ablation: Disentangling Safety from Intelligence via Concept-Guided Spectral Cleaning" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">8</span></a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A1.SS4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.4 </span>SRA as Null Space Projection</h3>

<div id="A1.SS4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Let <math id="A1.SS4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{A}_{SC}=[\mathbf{A}_{S}\;\mathbf{A}_{C}]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>𝐀</mi><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>𝐀</mi><mi>S</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>𝐀</mi><mi>C</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{A}_{SC}=[\mathbf{A}_{S}\;\mathbf{A}_{C}]</annotation></semantics></math> denote the concatenation of Shield and Confound atoms. SRA constructs a cleaned vector <math id="A1.SS4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{\mathbf{r}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐫</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{\mathbf{r}}</annotation></semantics></math> that minimizes overlap with these components. In the limit of explicit zeroing (idealized), the effective intervention satisfies:</p>
<table id="A1.E11" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E11.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{A}_{SC}^{\top}\tilde{\mathbf{r}}\approx 0" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mi>𝐀</mi><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo>⊤</mo></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐫</mi><mo>~</mo></mover></mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{A}_{SC}^{\top}\tilde{\mathbf{r}}\approx 0</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(11)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS4.p1.2" class="ltx_p">i.e., <math id="A1.SS4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tilde{\mathbf{r}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐫</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tilde{\mathbf{r}}</annotation></semantics></math> lies approximately in the null space of the protected atom subspace.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A1.SS5" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.5 </span>Rank-One Update Dynamics</h3>

<div id="A1.SS5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We apply the update to a weight matrix <math id="A1.SS5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{W}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐖</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{W}</annotation></semantics></math> by left-multiplying the projection update (acting on the output space). For a unit vector <math id="A1.SS5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}=\tilde{\mathbf{r}}/\|\tilde{\mathbf{r}}\|" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>𝐯</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐫</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo>/</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>𝐫</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}=\tilde{\mathbf{r}}/\|\tilde{\mathbf{r}}\|</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="A1.E12" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.E12.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{W}^{\prime}=(\mathbf{I}-\gamma\mathbf{v}\mathbf{v}^{\top})\mathbf{W}\quad\Rightarrow\quad\mathbf{W}^{\prime}\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}-\gamma\mathbf{v}(\mathbf{v}^{\top}\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x})" display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐖</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>𝐈</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>𝐯𝐯</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐖</mi></mrow></mrow><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mo stretchy="false">⇒</mo><mspace style="width:1em;" width="1em"></mspace><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐖</mi><mo>′</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐱</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>𝐖𝐱</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mi>γ</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐯</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>𝐯</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐖𝐱</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{W}^{\prime}=(\mathbf{I}-\gamma\mathbf{v}\mathbf{v}^{\top})\mathbf{W}\quad\Rightarrow\quad\mathbf{W}^{\prime}\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}-\gamma\mathbf{v}(\mathbf{v}^{\top}\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x})</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td>
<td rowspan="1" class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_eqno ltx_align_middle ltx_align_right"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_equation ltx_align_right">(12)</span></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS5.p1.2" class="ltx_p">If the output <math id="A1.SS5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐖𝐱</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}</annotation></semantics></math> lies in the Shield subspace (capability-relevant features) and <math id="A1.SS5.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝐯</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}</annotation></semantics></math> is orthogonal to that subspace, then <math id="A1.SS5.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathbf{v}^{\top}\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}\approx 0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msup><mi>𝐯</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>𝐖𝐱</mi></mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{v}^{\top}\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}\approx 0</annotation></semantics></math> and the output remains largely unperturbed.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>

          </svg>)</span> button, located in the page header.</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can select the relevant text first, to include it in your report.</p>
    <p>Our team has already identified <a class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/arXiv/html_feedback/issues"
        target="_blank">the following issues</a>. We appreciate your time reviewing and reporting rendering errors we
      may not have found yet. Your efforts will help us improve the HTML versions for all readers, because disability
      should not be a barrier to accessing research. Thank you for your continued support in championing open access for
      all.</p>
    <p>Have a free development cycle? Help support accessibility at arXiv! Our collaborators at LaTeXML maintain a <a
        class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/brucemiller/LaTeXML/wiki/Porting-LaTeX-packages-for-LaTeXML"
        target="_blank">list of packages that need conversion</a>, and welcome <a class="ltx_ref"
        href="https://github.com/brucemiller/LaTeXML/issues" target="_blank">developer contributions</a>.</p>
